title: Bisulfite Sequencing Protocol for Astrocytes
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Extract genomic DNA using the QIAamp DNA Mini Kit (Qiagen) following manufacturer's instructions
Bisulfite conversion efficiency exceeded 99% in all samples
Adapter trimming and quality control with CutAdapt (RRID:SCR_011841)
Methylation analysis in R using methylKit
Differentially methylated regions annotated using UCSC genome annotations

steps.title: Harvest astrocytes with TrypLE
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TrypLE Express to each well of a 6‑well plate and harvest the astrocytes.

steps.title: Centrifuge and purify DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the harvested cells and carry out column‑based DNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells (speed and time as per standard protocol).
Process the cell pellet using a column‑based DNA purification kit.

steps.title: Elute and quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA in 80 µL and quantify it; the concentration should fall within 51–198 ng/µL before submission.

substeps.instruction: Elute DNA in 80 µL elution buffer.
Measure DNA concentration and verify it is between 51 and 198 ng/µL.

steps.title: Submit DNA for RRBS
steps.instruction: Send the purified DNA to Zymo Research for Reduced Representation Bisulfite Sequencing (RRBS).

steps.title: Align reads with Bismark
steps.instruction: Align the sequencing reads to the hg38 reference genome using Bismark (RRID:SCR_005604).

steps.title: Assess differential methylation
steps.instruction: Perform differential methylation analysis using logistic regression with false discovery rate (FDR) correction.
